t: Evolution E800MSSL strong and stable mitre saw stand built for convenience and reliability. Supports up to 150kg. Ideal for use on site or in home workshops. Features folding legs and lightweight frame, allowing easy transportation and storage. Quick to set up and easy to move, the stand provides a sturdy workstation with all the core strength and stability of the previous model. Folds flat for storage. Universal fit compatible with most mitre saws.
